Frog One's bistro pâté.d: Chicken livers seared pink and flamed with cognac, blended with butter, shallot and thyme. Cornichons, warm baguette.

Stakeout coffee and doughnuts.d: Drip coffee in a paper cup, two warm cake doughnuts rolled in cinnamon sugar.

Charnier's steak frites.d: Sirloin seared hard and rested, warm tarragon and shallot butter sauce, hand-cut potatoes fried twice.

Crème caramel.d: Vanilla custard baked in a water bath, chilled, turned out under amber syrup.

Marseille mauresque.d: Pastis and orgeat over ice, clouded with water.
Marseille mauresque.note: A glass from the old port.
